[Show MECOS] Built a 87% time-saving automation bot for Local Retail Store

Built a bot for Local Retail Store that cut their Manual inventory tracking and order processing consuming 15+ hours per week by 87%.

I recently finished an automation project for Local Retail Store that I'm really proud of.

The problem: Manual Inventory Tracking And Order Processing Consuming 15+ Hours Per Week was consuming 15 hours per week.
The solution: A custom Python bot using browser automation and data pipelines.
The result: Down to 2 hour per week. (87% reduction)

What's interesting is that the biggest challenge wasn't the code — it was understanding their workflow well enough to simplify it.

Tech used: Python, Playwright, ChromaDB, FastAPI

If your team is drowning in manual work, happy to do a free 15-min process audit. DM me.
